Coverage · international · state & local · contractual

The same governance, across every jurisdiction.

Regulations aren’t only federal. Baltor pins corpora to whichever source is authoritative — an EU regulation, an IMO convention, a state statute, or a signed contract — and reconciles on change. Same pin → watch → reconcile model as the Federal Register; different source of truth. Not legal advice — the source in force is the authority, and Baltor preserves its citation and receipt.

Any authoritative source, pinned by citation
One model, every source. Federal (eCFR / Federal Register), international (EU, IMO, WHO, WCO, Codex, ILO, ISO), sub-federal (state statutes, municipal codes) and contractual (carrier SLAs, internal policy) all reconcile through the same pipeline. What this is not: not legal advice, not a memorized snapshot — Baltor serves the source in force with its citation and receipt, and holds superseded values out. See also Federal Register coverage.
